    have e: "y + 1 = (n - 1) + t" using key' n by linarith
    have "(y + 1) mod n = n - 1"

      also have "\<dots> = (n - 1) mod n"
        by (simp add: mod_mult_self1)
      also have "\<dots> = n - 1"
        using n by (intro Nat.mod_less) simp

  qed

  proof
    assume gn: "gcd y n = n"
    have "n dvd y"
      using gn by (metis gcd_dvd1)
    then obtain k where k: "y = n * k" by blast

    also have "\<dots> = 1"
      using n by (intro Nat.mod_less) simp
    finally have "(y + 1) mod n = 1" .
    with ne1 show False by contradiction
  qed
  show ?thesis using gpos g1 g2 gle by linarith
qed

theorem shor_factor:
  assumes n: "1 < n" and ord: "is_order n a r" and even: "even r"
    and not_minus_one: "a ^ (r div 2) mod n \<noteq> n - 1"
  shows "1 < gcd (a ^ (r div 2) - 1) n \<and> gcd (a ^ (r div 2) - 1) n < n"
proof -
  have ord': "0 < r \<and> a ^ r mod n = 1 \<and> (\<forall>k. 0 < k \<longrightarrow> k < r \<longrightarrow> a ^ k mod n \<noteq> 1)"
    using ord unfolding is_order_def by blast
  then have hr: "0 < r" and har: "a ^ r mod n = 1"
    and hmin: "\<forall>k. 0 < k \<longrightarrow> k < r \<longrightarrow> a ^ k mod n \<noteq> 1"
    by blast+
  obtain s where hs: "r = 2 * s" using even by (auto elim: evenE)
  have hsr: "r div 2 = s" using hs by simp
  have hs0: "0 < s" using hr hs by simp
  have hsr2: "s < r" using hs0 hs by simp
  have ha0: "a \<noteq> 0"
  proof
    assume "a = 0"
    then have "a ^ r = 0"
      using hr by (simp add: zero_power)
    with har show False by simp
  qed
  have hpos: "0 < a ^ s"
    using ha0 by (intro pow_pos) (simp_all add: Nat.pos_of_ne_zero)
  have hy0: "a ^ s = (a ^ s - 1) + 1"
    using hpos by simp
  obtain y where hy': "y = a ^ s - 1" by blast
  have hy: "a ^ s = y + 1"
    using hy0 hy' by simp
  have hsq: "a ^ r = (y + 1) * (y + 1)"
  proof -
    have "a ^ r = a ^ s * a ^ s"
      by (simp add: hs mult_2 power_add)
    then show ?thesis using hy by simp
  qed
  have dv: "n dvd y * (y + 2)"
  proof -
    have dm: "n * (a ^ r div n) + a ^ r mod n = a ^ r"
      by (rule Nat.div_add_mod)
    have e: "(y + 1) * (y + 1) = y * (y + 2) + 1"
      by (simp add: algebra_simps)
    have "y * (y + 2) = n * (a ^ r div n)"
      using dm har hsq e by linarith
    then show ?thesis unfolding dvd_def by blast
  qed
  have ne1: "(y + 1) mod n \<noteq> 1"
  proof -
    have "a ^ s mod n \<noteq> 1"
      using hmin hs0 hsr2 by blast
    then show ?thesis using hy by simp
  qed
  have nem1: "(y + 1) mod n \<noteq> n - 1"
  proof -
    have "a ^ s mod n \<noteq> n - 1"
      using not_minus_one hsr by simp
    then show ?thesis using hy by simp
  qed
  have ymain: "a ^ (r div 2) - 1 = y"
    using hsr hy hy' by simp
  show ?thesis
    using sf_core[OF n dv ne1 nem1] ymain by simp
qed

end
